name: Rayarakana Estate
location: Mullayanagiri, Seethalayanagiri and Rudragiri ranges, Karnataka
story: This century-old family farm that grows Arabica varieties under forest shade. Perennial streams run through the estate, and a mini hydroelectric unit meets its lighting needs.

name: Lakshmi Estate
story: A family-owned farm where every generation has contributed to the growth of the estate.
